A '''Human male''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]].

==Biography==
The captain was the commanding officer of the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]'' when [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kirst (admiral)|Kirst]] was away. During the attempt to kill several prominent [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], he picked up the skeleton crew, including the Admiral, from the [[Starcrusher (decoy)|''Starcrusher'' decoy]].
He attempted to stop the internal attack by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in his [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|interceptor]], but failed and was killed with the rest of the crew when their [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] were captured by a star's gravity well and crashed into it.
